heading: Audeohost has your events, and directions to get your customers there.
subhead: Audeohost focuses on venues and connecting customers. Your events, once scheduled are in the app on a customer or future customer's phone. When they prefer your venue within a certain geographical area, your events are shown first!

beats.title: Marketing up to 30 days out, not just today's discovery
beats.text: Trivia, live music, comedy, and every match on every screen — published up to a month ahead in the same Portal.

beats.title: The build-up and the analysis, not just the 90 minutes
beats.text:
Pre-game, game-time and post-game, Audeohost gives your guests the TV commentary on their phone.
If you switch to music at half-time, game watchers can stick with the half-time show and never miss a beat. Post game is the same, they still have the commentary so nothing's lost.

beats.title: Connect once, stay top of the list
beats.text: Guests who favourite your venue on Audeohost sees it promoted first the next time they're deciding where to go. Audeohost is the source for every event at that venue, from day one. Your still on the events list so your venue is key in the area.

beatStrip: Audeohost is your whole venue, a month out. Customers connect, find your events, find you and are, and know where to go in future.
